steps.description: Create an executable bash script at /app/greet.sh that prints exactly 'hello' (followed by a newline) when run; must exist, be chmod +x, and exit 0.

Modify /app/greet.sh so it reads the name from /app/config.txt (uploaded to WORKDIR by this step) and prints 'Hello, <name>!' instead of hardcoding 'hello'; verified against EXPECTED_NAME=Harbor / EXPECTED_GREETING='Hello, Harbor!'.
steps.source: steps/implement/instruction.md; task.toml [[steps]] name="implement" min_reward=0.5, verifier.env EXPECTED_NAME/EXPECTED_GREETING, healthcheck 'test -x /app/greet.sh'

steps.description: Create /app/README.md documenting greet.sh: a level-1 heading 'greet.sh', a mention of config.txt, and a fenced bash code block showing how to run the script, without breaking the existing greet.sh.
